about: New-build: what to take into account

An apartment from a developer is best planned around you from the start: moving walls, planning sockets, lighting, storage and air conditioning. That is why we begin a new-build renovation with a design project — the crew works without rework, and you see the result in advance.
We can prepare the design and estimate before you even get the keys, so no months are lost. Furniture and lighting can be ordered directly from China in parallel with the renovation.
